text: Three teenage friends, playing at a legend, [summon Aïsha Kandisha|trigger|calling on unseen powers], the avenging spirit of Moroccan folklore, and Amélie asks her to [punish the former boyfriend who hurt her|wrong|sexual violation]. Kandisha is not satisfied with one victim and turns on every man near them, including their own families, seeking [a body to be reborn in|wants|a way into life]. The girls turn to a father and son versed in Islamic spiritual practice as she [sets her sights on Amélie's younger brother Antoine|who_suffers|families and parents].
